summary_paragraph: The patient, a man with end-stage renal disease on hemodialysis, epilepsy, and cardiomyopathy, was admitted after becoming altered during dialysis, prompting a stroke alert. He had a witnessed seizure in the CT scanner and tested positive for influenza A. Brain imaging showed no acute stroke or hemorrhage. He was treated with oseltamivir and had his anti-seizure medications adjusted, including increased levetiracetam and continued oxcarbazepine with post-dialysis dosing. He remained seizure-free, returned to baseline mental status, and completed dialysis. Discharge was to an extended care facility with follow-up plans for thyroid ultrasound, dental evaluation, and monitoring of a small pulmonary nodule.
problems: Epilepsy, unspecified, not intractable, without status epilepticus
Influenza due to other identified influenza virus with other respiratory manifestations
Hemiplegia and hemiparesis following cerebral infarction affecting right dominant side
Atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary artery without angina pectoris
Personal history of Methicillin resistant Staphylococcus aureus infection
